name: Core Libs - API & Assessment
architecture_notes: API layer utilizes a centralized `client.ts` fetch wrapper accessed via domain-specific adapters (Admin, Assessment, Employer, Voice). The Assessment Engine leverages the CognitiveAnalyzer to orchestrate AI generation, heuristic pre-processing, and a two-pass validation system. Robust fallback mechanisms and a defined skill registry drive strict, calibrated scoring and comprehensive diagnostic assessment generation.
anomalies_or_issues: None observed that block production readiness. Test files run on vitest and properly assert subcriteria weights, error handling, and scoring limits.
